FADE IN:

EXT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS - DAY
Kan arrived on campus.
It was his first time.
He felt a buzz of excitement.
He was the last of his friends to gain admission.
He stepped onto the grounds.
It felt like catching up.
He finally belonged.

ACT I
INT. KAN'S HOSTEL ROOM - DAY
Kan unpacked his bags.
He settled into his new room.
He felt excited for his new start.

He lost his wallet.
It held his money.
It held his friend's contact number.
This was his only contact back home.

CUT TO:
INT. KAN'S HOSTEL ROOM - LATER
Kan's phone rang.
His friend called.
Strangers held his wallet.
They provided a number.

Kan was new to campus.
He knew nothing of the city.
The wallet held all his money.
He called the number.

A voice answered.
It instructed him to meet.
He had to go outside the school gates.

CUT TO:
EXT. UNIVERSITY GATES - LATE AFTERNOON
Kan walked past the familiar gates.
He entered an unknown part of the city.
He felt afraid.

ACT II
EXT. OFF-CAMPUS LOCATION - LATE AFTERNOON
Kan found a small group of men.
Seven men sat together.
They drank from bottles.
He felt uneasy.

They waved him over.
They offered him a seat.
He took the seat.

They told him to drink.
He said no.
The mood turned fast.
He had no choice.
He drank the liquid.

CUT TO:
EXT. OFF-CAMPUS LOCATION - DUSK
Kan tried to leave.
He said he needed his hostel.

One man was EMK.
He was the executioner.

Kan watched the other men.
They greeted EMK with respect.
They used both hands.

EMK softened slightly.
He asked about Kan's studies.
He offered Kan help.
He gave Kan his number.

ACT III
EXT. UNIVERSITY GATES - DUSK
Kan left the scene.
He felt relief. His wallet was back.
He walked toward the campus gates.
He did not know the group's power.
He did not know the risk.
FADE OUT.
